zipCodeComparison.areaName: Borough of Glen Rock (All Residential Districts)
zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Rock Road Center, Central, Byrd, Coleman & Hamilton Districts

neighborhoods.name: Central Glen Rock & Rock Road Downtown
neighborhoods.description: Historic downtown village center surrounding the Glen Rock Main Line and Boro Hall NJ Transit rail stations.

neighborhoods.name: Richard E. Byrd & Highwood District
neighborhoods.description: Established residential northern section surrounding Byrd Elementary School and Ridgewood border.

neighborhoods.name: Alexander Hamilton & Coleman District
neighborhoods.description: Spacious suburban neighborhood surrounding Hamilton Ave campus, middle school, and high school.

neighborhoods.name: Radburn Border & East Glen Rock
neighborhoods.description: Eastern residential zone adjoining Fair Lawn Radburn border, featuring classic mid-century colonials and split-levels.

neighborhoods.name: Doremus Park & South Glen Rock
neighborhoods.description: Parkside community surrounding Doremus Avenue, municipal arboretum, and Diamond Brook pathways.

equityAnalysis.summary: Glen Rock maintains exceptionally consistent residential ratables across all four elementary school feeder zones, resulting in balanced per-pupil local tax effort throughout the borough.
